title: 3D - CAD
subtitle: 3D - CAD
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn the fundamentals of 3D-CAD systems (2)learn the skills to handle 3D-CAD systems as aircraft design tool (3)learn how CAD is used in aircraft design and manufacturing
advice: In this course, students will learn the 3D-CAD system, which supports engineers in design and manufacture. We will cover the following materials: 1. Computational design used for the aircraft design and manufacturing process 2. CAD/CAM/CAE systems 3. 3D part modeling 4. Assembly modeling Students will also learn about Additive Manufacturing (3D printer), which is useful for manufacturing 3D geometry. Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves. Students should not be late or absent from the class.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Mechanical Drawing I and II.

activityGoals.body: Be able to describe computer usage in an aircraft manufacturing process
Be able to describe the role of the CAD system in an aircraft manufacturing process
Be able to design a part model based on design logic by using CAD modeling
Be able to design an assembly model by making use of the assembly function

    授業の概要および学習上の助言   In this course, students will learn the 3D-CAD system, which supports engineers in design and manufacture. We will cover the following materials: 1. Computational design used for the aircraft design and manufacturing process 2. CAD/CAM/CAE systems 3. 3D part modeling 4. Assembly modeling Students will also learn about Additive Manufacturing (3D printer), which is useful for manufacturing 3D geometry. Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves. Students should not be late or absent from the class.
